column1: # The frozen C4 production profile for `panvar genotype`: panel-anchored adaptive completion.
# Committed, hashed into every run's status, and never edited in place: a change is a new profile.
# Candidate union: proposal width 256 (allele-prefix pairs), K = 128 grouped-prefix mosaics beside every
# panel diplotype, phase audit 0 -- the caller settings of the C4 development LOO campaign
# (tests/results/genotype_loo_c4_development_7e37bb4/settings.tsv), with its per-pass scorer caps and
# Repair: 32 local pairs per block, at most 11 rounds, the 384 MiB planned origin cache, and the
# cumulative caps the single-start searches were accepted under (4.9e9 physical origins, 4.2e9 state
# classes, 1.4e10 piece hits, 1.4e10 latent pairs). A round's neighbourhood is at most 670 candidates.
# Eight threads; deterministic, so the result does not depend on the count. The process is stopped at
# 2.5 GiB of physical footprint (macOS phys_footprint; RESOURCE_REFUSAL, no genotype).
